name: lamp-burnout
description: M4 Phase 3 scenario (epic #163; timers): the lamp burns out. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. Take the lamp in the living room, turn it on (LANTERN enables the LNTIN clock, CTICK 350, 77dung.mud:2388), then `wait` 118 times in the lit living room. WAIT (77rooms.mud:1619) runs CLOCK-DEMON up to three more times per turn and stops when an event fires. LIGHT-INT (77act1.mud:2006) re-arms LNTIN from LAMP-TICKS [50 30 20 10 4 0] and prints LAMP-TELLS: four times "The lamp appears to be getting dimmer.", then "The lamp is dying.", then "I hope you have more light than from a lamp." and OLIGHT? 0. Then `turn on lamp` ("You can't turn that on."), `look`, the rug and the trap door, `down` into the dark cellar ("It is pitch black. ..."), `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/LAMP-BURNOUT-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
